answer: A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The wharf counter is kept in willow and pulse reveals each reset. Someone as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2269 identities would post 2737 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
